en.heading: What I work on
en.intro: My work is on large language models (evaluation, alignment and post-training) and on AI for finance.
en.outro: The five accepted papers above are all on the evaluation side. My work on training itself is still small-scale: fewer than 200 preference pairs per adapter, one algorithm, one A100 GPU. Taking that part to full research scale is what I want to do in a PhD.
